senses.gloss: उद् ind. A prefix to verbal and nominal themes implying- (1) superiority, (e.g. उद्बल); (2) separation, disjunction, (e.g. उद्गच्छति); (3) motion upwards, (e.g. उत्तिष्ठति); (4) gain, (e.g. उत्पन्न); (5) publicity, (e.g. उच्चरति); (6) pride, (e.g. उत्सेक); (7) liberation, (e.g. उद्गत); (8) absence, (e.g. उत्पथ); (9) breaking, blowing, opening, (e.g. उत्फुल्ल), (10) preeminence, (e.g. उद्दिष्ट), (11) power, (e.g. उत्साह). In composition with nouns, उद् forms adjectival and adverbial compounds, उद्बाहु, उन्निद्रम्, उत्पथम् &c.
